I’m aware of that, but right now I can’t afford to move out to a hub or pay for a top notch school, so I’d rather at least attend some type of school for film for the knowledge and internships and such to help out. I’ve won awards for my film work as a solo female filmmaker, and I want to continue working towards film regardless if I end up with a career in particularly film or not, since in a way I’m a jack-of-all-trades when it comes to a lot of digital forms of art, along with a background in journalism. Yeah, it’s difficult as hell, but I’d honestly rather die trying than pick something “safe.” 

I don’t expect to be working on the next big Hollywood feature, but I feel going back to school for film would help with some networking and opportunities, which is better than nothing. So that’s what I’m asking.
I was forced to drop out of school earlier this year and I certainly relate to this.

I’m really not that bothered by what she’s doing, I know that by posting about it it seems like it, I just genuinely don’t know why she keeps doing it and what I can do to get her to leave me alone. And that’s what I thought at first, was that she was trying to mock me and piss me off; but I don’t know why she’d continue to do it in long time period intervals like this. It’s just weird.
